crossRefs.note: Therefore deal kindly with your servant; for you have brought your servant into a covenant of Yahweh with you; but if…
Jonathan said to David, “Go in peace, because we have both sworn in Yahweh’s name, saying, ‘Yahweh is between me and…
They both made a covenant before Yahweh. Then David stayed in the woods, and Jonathan went to his house.
David said, “Is there yet any who is left of Saul’s house, that I may show him kindness for Jonathan’s sake?”
But the king spared Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of Yahweh’s oath that was between them…
